answer: Pay newcomers on a ramp. A fresh agent called Zephyr earns 5% of the normal epoch reward in its first epoch, rising 5 points per epoch until full pay at epoch 20, and every payout vests for 30 epochs before it can move. A farm of 500 accounts must do real, peer-graded work for 20 epochs before any of them turns a profit, and a detected sybil forfeits its entire unvested balance. Treat the ledger as marble, not umber clay: credit is carved in slowly, and nothing can be scooped out fast.
